name: exploratory_projects_public
note: Exploratory interconnection concepts announced publicly but present in neither the ENTSO-E TYNDP 2026 draft portfolio nor a promoter register. Geometry is an INDICATIVE straight line between plausible landing regions; no route has been published. Context only: nothing here is modelled.
